description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/sigdispatch.t's residue is two facts:

 (a) `$SIG{"__DIE__\0whoops"}` must be "No such hook: __DIE__\0whoops at ..." --
     perl treats the %SIG key as a NUL-terminated C string for the LOOKUP but
     reports the whole key, and a trailing NUL is stripped.  The rows are
     "Fetching %SIG hooks with an extra trailing nul is nul-clean" and
     "Arbitrary signal lookup through %SIG is clean".

 (b) the file's last two rows (never produced) raise a signal from INSIDE a
     handler and assert the deferred dispatch runs it exactly once and that a
     `die` in the handler reaches the enclosing eval.

Both are %SIG-model work; (a) is the cheap half and is a message plus a key
normalisation, (b) needs a deferred-signal queue.

See also #1924 (`$Config{d_sigprocmask}` is one of the keys PCL's %Config
subset does not have) and #1927 (op/signame_canonical.t).
subject: %SIG lookups are not NUL-clean, and a signal raised inside a handler is not deferred (op/sigdispatch.t, 5 rows + 2 never produced)
